name: Lunar Season ~150 Bun no 1 no Koibito~
original_name: るな・シーズン～150分の1の恋人～
source:
Main character is a high school student who has bad luck with women, being turned down by 149 girls in three years. The relationship with the 150th girl finally lasts a whole month. On a helpless impulse he rapes her, and relations are on their way to disconnection. Is protagonist doomed?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名女人缘极差的高中生，三年里连续被149名女孩拒绝。与第150名女孩的关系终于维持了整整一个月，他却因无法抑制的冲动强暴了她，两人的感情也濒临破裂。主人公注定无可救药吗？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
